No GPU, no training, no batch regression battery, no market data, no outcome access. The read-only frozen bundle experiments/lab_asset_a2/a2_exit_20260905/ was consumed strictly read-only: bytes read, never written; per-file sha256 re-verified against bundle_manifest.json inside the two fixture tests before any projection. The E-2 preflight re-run was NOT executed (out of E-1 scope).
spec_deviations: Round grouping = distinct execution.clocks.match_ts ascending (engine clock / last_match_ts); the client-supplied execution.round_id is carried as metadata only. Reason: round_id is client-controlled and uniformly 0 in the frozen fixtures, so it cannot define the round grid; the engine clock is the native clearing-round boundary and is the narrower, more deterministic choice.

Rounds without executions are NOT part of the corpus (no empty-round rows in the grid); the documented no-event token stays reachable by calling fexec_round_features on an empty payload sequence directly. Reason: an execution-less round carries zero F_exec information, and inventing round indices the tape does not determine would be less deterministic.

A round touching more than n_slots distinct price levels raises ValueError instead of truncating. Reason: silent truncation would violate the conserving-channel and replay guarantees; fail-loud is the conservative contract.

Slot semantics: slots index the round's DISTINCT EXECUTION PRICES ascending (touched-and-cleared levels with their executed quantities), right-padded to n_slots with quantity-0 slots at price 0 (never-clearable; cash-inert since allocation x price = 0). The full resting book per level is NOT reconstructed - book state is not tape-derivable (request-side events excluded) and stays with E-4 regenerate(). Reason: pure-selection scope; deterministic from execution payloads alone.

channels_cumulative is emitted as the zero-base cumsum of channels_delta. Reason: the ABS-head target base for L1/L2 adapters; true cumulative engine STATE (cash/inventory levels from the prestate) is E-4 scope and would require prestate arithmetic outside the selection contract.

seed is identity binding only (hashed into corpus_hash); the projector has zero stochastic consumers. Reason: deterministic pure function per the contracts section 2.4 global-RNG lesson; rejecting negative seeds.

Module placed at ecomd/corpus/fexec_projector.py (new subpackage) rather than scripts/. Reason: it imports torch and ecomd.models.fact_surrogate, must be importable by ecomd training code, and must sit under the mypy files=[ecomd] scope; engine modules are referenced structurally via Protocols (FexecPrestate, FexecTapeRecord), not imported.

Three-hash identity design: tape_hash (full tape incl. request-side records: provenance), content_hash (selection-only: corpus content), corpus_hash (binds projector id/version, grammar, session/prestate commitment, seed, n_slots, dtype, tape_hash, content_hash). Reason: makes the pure-selection property testable - request-side perturbations change provenance hashes but never content.

Enrichment v3.1 fixtures (experiments/lab_asset_a2/enrichment_20260906/) are NOT projected here: REQUIRED_SCHEMA_VERSION == 'lab-asset-v3' is enforced exactly. Reason: G3 pins schema_version == lab-asset-v3; the enrichment bundle is a v3.1 extension consumed by S1a post-D0, out of E-1 scope.

Engine-live payloads (dataclass ThreeClocks, StrEnum values) are canonicalized (dataclasses.asdict recursion) inside _select_execution_payload and tape_hash. Reason: a regenerated in-memory tape and its JSON-loaded recorded form must hash identically, which the raw objects would not (json.dumps TypeError); canonicalization is the minimal deterministic normalizer.
interface_notes: Lineage invariance is by construction: the features matrix is emitted by the frozen fexec_round_features / FEXEC_ROUND_FEATURES imported from ecomd.models.fact_surrogate - no reimplementation exists to drift.

FexecCorpus.fields map onto FactSurrogateBatch: features -> features, channels_cumulative -> channels (cast to float by the adapter), slot_prices -> slot_prices; channels_init must come from E-4 (prestate cash/inventory levels), not from this projector.

Structural Protocols accept both engine-live objects (TapeRecord with dataclass payload values) and JSON-round-tripped dicts; only the session_start record's exact field set is validated (exactly {session_id, schema_version, allocation_rule, prestate_hash}).

The projector re-verifies the session_start prestate_hash against a recomputed canonical hash of the passed prestate (dataclasses.asdict path), so a mismatched (prestate, tape) pair is rejected rather than silently projected.

Validation on every execution payload: all 7 required F_exec fields present, no keys outside the frozen selection (extra request-side keys are REJECTED, not dropped - an explicit exclusion check), quantity/price/round_id/match_ts integer-typed and match_ts nonnegative, allocation_draw exact field set when present.
